name: @pipeworx/mcp-tankerkoenig

tools.name: tankerkoenig_stations_nearby
tools.description: German gas station fuel prices near a location — Benzinpreise Germany, real-time from the official MTS-K feed. Find the cheapest diesel, E5, or E10 near a point in Germany with price in EUR per liter, brand, address, distance, and open status. Coordinates are required: geocode a German city or address first (e.g. via a geocoding tool) — Berlin is lat 52.52, lng 13.40. Data covers Germany only. Example: tankerkoenig_stations_nearby({ latitude: 52.52, longitude: 13.40, radius_km: 5, fuel: "diesel", sort: "price" })

latitude.description: Latitude of the search center (Germany), e.g. 52.52 for Berlin

longitude.description: Longitude of the search center (Germany), e.g. 13.40 for Berlin

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometers (default 5, maximum 25 — larger values are clamped)

fuel.description: Fuel type: "e5" (Super 95), "e10" (Super E10), "diesel", or "all" for all three prices per station (default "all")

sort.description: Sort order: "distance" (default) or "price" (cheapest first). Sorting by price requires a single fuel type (e5, e10, or diesel), the API rejects sort by price when fuel is "all"

open_only.description: Return only stations that are currently open (default false)

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own free Tankerkoenig API key (creativecommons.tankerkoenig.de)

tools.name: tankerkoenig_station_details
tools.description: Full detail for one German gas station by its Tankerkoenig station id (UUID from tankerkoenig_stations_nearby): opening times, current E5 / E10 / diesel prices in EUR per liter, brand, address, state, and open status. MTS-K real-time data, Germany only. Example: tankerkoenig_station_details({ station_id: "94e70fc4-b22f-4e5a-877f-bc1082cdae81" })

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own free Tankerkoenig API key (creativecommons.tankerkoenig.de)

tools.name: tankerkoenig_prices
tools.description: Bulk current fuel prices (E5, E10, diesel in EUR per liter) for up to 10 German gas stations by station id — the efficient refresh call for price-watch and price-alert flows once station ids are known. MTS-K real-time Benzinpreise, Germany only. Example: tankerkoenig_prices({ station_ids: ["94e70fc4-b22f-4e5a-877f-bc1082cdae81", "278130b1-e062-4a0f-80cc-19e486b4c024"] })

station_ids.description: List of station UUIDs (1 to 10) from tankerkoenig_stations_nearby

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own free Tankerkoenig API key (creativecommons.tankerkoenig.de)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-tankerkoenig forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the tankerkoenig pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
